findings.F1: Across all wide days (width at or above its 75th percentile, 1.89, folds B and C), the lower the close in the range times the width, the higher the next day's unusual return; the link holds in every profile split: agitated Spearman 0.215 (n 892, p 8e-11), calm 0.147 (n 1174, p 4.5e-7), falling 0.206 (n 538, p 1.4e-6), rising 0.143 (n 608, p 4e-4), choppy 0.137 (n 209, p 0.048).
findings.F2: In a falling calm market, wide days closing in the top third of their range are followed by an unusual next-day return of -1.05 % (t -2.02, 84 cases on 45 days); wide falling-calm days closing in the middle or bottom third show none (-0.23 %, t -0.34; -0.16 %, t -0.20).
findings.F3: The book's own short cases in folds B and C gain 2.06 % per case in the short direction (t 2.80, 30 cases on 23 days), against 0.42 % (t 0.90, 122 cases) over all four folds, so folds A and D carry the weakness.
findings.F4: Pinning the close to the high adds nothing: over all profiles, the widest-quarter days closing in the top tenth have an unusual next-day return of -0.09 % (t -0.18, 239 cases), against -0.55 % (t -1.43, 479 cases) for closes at 0.7 to 0.9 of the range.
findings.F5: The falling-calm fade lasts one day only: wide calm days closing in the top third have a 3-day unusual return of +0.19 % (t 0.24, 163 grid cases on 76 days).
findings.F6: In a rising calm market, wide days closing in the bottom third rebound by +1.94 % unusual over the next day (t 3.05, 92 cases on 49 days); this is the only profile cell of the 18 read where that rebound has a t above 2.4.
findings.F7: The wide low-close rebound appears in every year read, 2018 +0.63 % (t 0.77), 2019 +0.46 %, 2020 +1.46 %, 2021 +1.85 % (t 2.48), 761 cases in all.
findings.F8: These do not stand out as patterns: weekday (every |t| < 1.2), the volume surge quintile (+0.52 %, t 1.93), and large down days scaled by the 30-day swing (rz below -1: +0.80 %, t 1.91 for -2 to -1). The last is already held many times in the map's agitated cells.

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, the higher a day closes within its high-to-low range, scaled by how wide that range is against the coin's 30-day swing of daily returns, the larger the coin's fall over the next day.
ideas.consequence: In a falling calm coin, a wide day ending in the upper part of its range is worth fading for one day, sized by width and close height rather than kept to closes pinned at the high.
ideas.name: falling calm graded high-close fade

ideas.idea: In a rising, calm market, the lower a day closes within its high-to-low range, scaled by how wide that range is against the coin's 30-day swing of daily returns, the larger the coin's rise over the next day.
ideas.consequence: In a calm uptrend, a wide day that ends near its low is a one-day dip to buy, larger the wider the day and the lower its close.
ideas.name: rising calm wide dip rebound
